changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE outbox_events ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, aggregate_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), published_at TIMESTAMP );
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_pending ON outbox_events (status, created_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING';
